name: PixArt Sigma

length_guidance: Craft around 210 words blending cinematic staging and painterly vocabulary.
detail_expectation: Mix bold color stories, lighting gradients, and stylistic references with intricate subject detail.
negative_prompt_default: blurry, low quality, distorted, oversaturated, watermark

provenance.notes: Ported verbatim. EricRollei's original field names and ordering preserved; platform_block lifted from text_to_image_node.py when present, otherwise empty (the master template + preferences/avoid/quality_tokens alone are enough for platforms without a bespoke block).
